description: The category tree of the Caper knowledge base, the cheapest way to orient before searching. Each node carries its `path` (a tagPath list_pages and search_wiki take), name, description, `pageCount` (pages filed at that path) and `pageCountDeep` (with every descendant). `tagPaths` lists every tag path that holds pages, including any the tree does not name.
name: get_categories
title: List categories
